stem:
Priya and her friends spent a rainy afternoon at school in Coimbatore. Each of them did something different.

Only one of them was truly doing science, because science means asking questions, observing, exploring and doing things to understand the world — not just memorising facts.

Which row matches the student, what they did, and whether it counts as science?

options.text: Rohan learnt the names of ten scientists by heart — this is science
Meena watched how ants carried crumbs and wondered why they walk in a line — this is science
Arjun copied the rainbow experiment from his notebook without asking any question — this is science
Sara recited the definitions of 'observation' and 'experiment' aloud — this is science

teacher.key_rationale: Only Meena is curious, observing, and asking a question about the world, which is what counts as science; Rohan and Sara are only memorising, and Arjun copies actions without a question. Key B.
